_comment: OSM-derived OpeningHours, kept separate from the hand-curated attractions.json
so ODbL share-alike never attaches to our own work (ADR-0005). Every row records
the element the value actually came from: OSM name matching is unreliable, so a
value must be auditable rather than re-derivable by name.
Partial by design. These rows are the spot-checks verified during the provider
import of the remaining ~63 sourced values is issue #25, which should key on
wikidata/OSM ids rather than fuzzy names — the automated name matcher used during
research under-counted, missing all five rows below.
